ns2:course.label: Pedology
ns2:course.description: The science of soil genesis, classification, and morphology. Includes factors of soil formation, properties and methods used in distinguishing soils, interpretation of soil profiles and soil stratigraphy, causes of soil variability, and the impact of soil properties upon soil management, land-use decisions, and the environment. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: NRES 201.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: NRES 201.
